capabilities: list plugins installed in the current vault
copy selected plugin folders to a target vault
create symlinks to plugins in a target vault
skip existing folders or conflicting symlinks without overwriting
extras: Installation is manual (copying plugin files into the vault) rather than through the community plugin store; includes an English/Chinese UI language switch.
problem: Obsidian stores plugins per vault, so users with multiple vaults must manually reinstall or copy the same plugins into each one.
summary: Desktop-only utility that shares community plugins between vaults by copying plugin folders or creating symlinks to them.
